method: Every entire source boundary patch is successively clipped against a complete halfspace representation of every target convex boundary patch plus an axis-aligned +/-0.000005mm cube. All rational inequalities exact. Full two-way coverage bounds surface Hausdorff distance; separate exact embedded-solid and signed volume audits remain required.
normal_fan_basis: Minkowski facet normals arise from a polygon face, cube face, or polygon-edge/cube-edge pair. Enumerating both polygon normals, six cube normals, and all +/- cross products of polygon edges with cube axes gives a complete supporting halfspace representation.
bbox_scope: Reported bboxes enclose nonzero matched boundary-envelope regions, not exact interior symmetric-difference cells.
